# Vendored origin

This crate is vendored into V.I.C.T.O.R. from the MIT-licensed `bse-fetch`
crate in BALD Search Engine. The copied snapshot includes the redirect
allowlist enforcement required by the V.I.C.T.O.R. adapter.

The vendored copy is intentionally self-contained and has no Cargo dependency
on a BALD checkout or Git repository. The MIT license is preserved in
`LICENSE`.
